'').startsWith('SO-V3019S2-ARIN')); const npc = (rt.extras.speech ?? []).filter((e) => e.origin === 'npc' && e.member === 'Arin'); const state = { at, npc }; if (at < 0) throw new Error('with two voices Arin must speak after the narrator: ' + JSON.stringify(state)); if (npc.length !== 1 || npc[0].messageId !== at || npc[0].generated !== false) throw new Error('the speech record must hold one scripted npc event at the posted message: ' + JSON.stringify(state)); return state;
